title: Practices between appointments with a specialist
description: Material chosen together and short notes for the next conversation.

blocks.text: The author’s psychotherapist recommended the app. That confirms one route to discovery, but does not prove that a person needs a shared dashboard or someone checking that the work was done.

quote.text: My therapist recommended what was then 10% Happier, and I started using it purely for sleep. I hung in there with no real understanding of meditation for 6 months before it clicked and my awareness saw true benefits

blocks.text: Save the recommended material and optional personal questions. Before the next appointment the person decides for themselves what to share. To begin with, a selection and a note are enough, without another person having standing access to the history.
Find out what gets lost between appointments
Test whether it is hard to find a recording, to recall the experience or to pass on a question. If the problem is only finding a link, an elaborate collaboration system will be beside the point.
